The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''23,643 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as the year '''12,810 after the Tho Yor Arrival''',<ref name="YearTYA" /> the year '''19,990 before the Treaty of Coruscant''',<ref name="YearTC" /> the year '''22,643 before the Ruusan Reformation''',<ref name="YearRuu" /> or the year '''23,608 before the Great ReSynchronizaton''',<ref name="YearGrS" /> was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]]. Around that time, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uphrades]] experienced significant volcanic activity that resulted in the planet's soil being especially fertile tens of thousands of years later.<ref name="Uphrades">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Uphrades|Uphrades}}</ref>
